kg_findings: PRO-RATA CANCELLATION IS INSUFFICIENT (the Samsung proof: ~20.5M prefs retired 2025-26 pro-rata ~10-12% per tranche, discount STILL widened 17->34%) — grade candidates on DISPROPORTIONATE pref retirement by SHARE COUNT, never discount width and never won-allocation.

THE CANCELLATION CATALYST AND THE DELISTING TRAP ARE THE SAME COIN: KRX designates/delists prefs under 200k listed shares (5 delisted Jun-2023); aggressive pref cancellation on a thin line RAISES liquidity-designation risk (SK Inc down to 1,787 prefs). Float floor = a sizing constraint AND an endgame mechanism (tender/squeeze-out at the bottom of the float).

V-ARC MECHANICS: 2024 value-up compressed the easy leg (CJ CheilJedang -17pp = the compressed exemplar); the 2025-26 common melt-up re-widened every liquid discount because index/ETF/AI flows chase COMMONS ONLY — a flow artifact ON a strengthening legal forcing function (fiduciary-to-all eff. 2025-07-22; MANDATORY 1yr treasury cancellation eff. 2026-03-06, Q1-26 cancels +159%; dividend separate-taxation eff. 2026-01-01 sunset 2028). Falsifier honestly held: even Hyundai's pref-friendliest program was swamped by common momentum + a DPS cut — the trade is partly an implicit short on common momentum.

KR TAX MECHANICS (corrected): omnibus brokers over-withhold at 22% statutory (the 15% treaty rate needs an NTS reclaim: Form 6166 + POA, ~6mo); NO Korean CGT for small US holders — so pref-discount P&L must be COMPRESSION-WEIGHTED with the dividend as a drag-bearing sweetener.
